ARunsLifeOnThePage\nA workflow starts, asks an operator a question and exits while the dashboard is open.\n    The list shows the run each time it speaks: running, blocked on a gate, then ended.
TheListIsOrdered\nThree runs report in the order finished, running, blocked. The list puts the blocked\n    run first, the running one next and the ended one last.

NarrowingTheList
An operator types in the filter box. The list keeps the runs that hold the text in their
    name, repo or node, matches without regard to case or the spaces around it, and shows every
    run again once the box is cleared.

TheAttendantIsSwitchedOnThePage\nAn operator opens Settings, ticks the attendant box, clears it, and goes back to the\n    runs. The pane names the mode each time, and the mode is kept across the return.

# Runs  (/)
inside: #runs-pane
first screen
reached from: the page opens on it; the Runs button of the left bar returns to it

components:
  #runs-pane h2      heading   'Runs'  the pane's title
  #runs-pane input[name=q] field     'Filter runs'  narrows the list to the runs whose name, repo, node, task or id holds the text typed
  #runs-list button.row button    'run' (per row)  one run: its state, repo and branch, short id, what it is doing
  #runs-list button.row .dot text      'state' (per row)  the run's state, on the row's data-state
  #runs-list button.row .repo-branch text      'repo' (per row)  the repo and branch the run works on, or a dash when it did not say
  #runs-list button.row .wid text      'short id' (per row)  # and the first four characters of the run's id
  #runs-list button.row .doing text      'doing' (per row)  the gate file a blocked run waits on
  #runs-list button.row .pulse text      'ended' (per row)  the word ended on a run that exited
  #runs-list .empty  text       the line shown when the list or the filter holds no run
  #statusbar         text       the count of runs per state and of repos and workers
  #activitybar .act-btn[data-mode=settings] button    'Settings'  opens the settings pane

sends (to /api):
  GET /api/state
  GET /api/settings/attend

# Settings  (/)
inside: #settings-pane
reached from: the Settings button of the left bar

components:
  #settings-pane h2  heading   'Settings'  the pane's title
  #setting-attend input[type=checkbox] check     'Attend parked and dead runs'  lets the attendant answer the gates that wait on an operator
  #setting-attend .setting-mode text      'mode'  the attendant's mode: off, or headless while it answers gates
  #activitybar .act-btn[data-mode=runs] button    'Runs'  returns to the run list

sends (to /api):
  GET /api/settings/attend
  POST /api/settings/attend
- **(none)**: the list holds no run of ours. Reached by: a fresh service, nothing done.
- **running**: the run reported progress and holds no gate. Reached by: ReportProgress r00.
- **blocked**: the run waits on one gate. Reached by: ReportGate r01.
- **finished**: the run exited with a code. Reached by: ReportExit r02.
- **Off**: no attendant answers the gates. Reached by: a fresh service, nothing done.
- **Headless**: an attendant answers the gates. Reached by: SwitchTheAttendant attendant on.
